# Merge bump tasks bypass the comm Gecko-pinning transform before field resolution

This landing makes pin_gecko_rev_yml yield bump-main and bump-esr153 tasks before resolving or consuming worker.gecko-rev. The action configuration adds explicit false clobber options to those bumps, removes the ESR-bump pin entry, and changes the release-to-ESR action to merge-day. Non-bump branch transitions retain the Gecko-revision replacement path. These are scoped comm generator/configuration facts; the imported schema and worker are unpaired, so the change does not prove schema acceptance, downstream field removal or a successful merge/clobber task.

Scope: Thunderbird merge automation bump and branch transition phases.
